newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Normandy appoints Ian Gould as group MD.
newsitem.headline: Normandy appoints Ian Gould as group MD.

text.p: Australian gold miner Normandy Mining Ltd said on Tuesday it has appointed Ian Gould, currently managing director of Rio Tinto Australia, as group managing director.
Normandy said current managing director Anthony Palmer would become managing director, Australia, until the end of the year when he would leave the group and return to his former business.

Gould, a geologist with 30 years international mining experience, would aim to expand the asset and exploration portfolio of the group, while at the same time promoting sustainable growth in earnings per share.
Normandy chairman Robert de Crespigny said Gould would bring his experience as a general manager to the group, whereas Palmer had been more focussed on operations.
"This appointment is very definitely to focus on ensuring we make more per share than we have in the past," de Crespigny told Reuters.
Normandy earlier this month said it had hired newspaper executive John Reynolds as group executive, strategy and structure, based on his management and human resources skills.
